original_query: select     s_store_name   ,s_company_id   ,s_street_number   ,s_street_name   ,s_street_type   ,s_suite_number   ,s_city   ,s_county   ,s_state   ,s_zip   ,sum(case when (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 30 ) then 1 else 0 end)  as "30 days"   ,sum(case when (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 30) and                  (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 60) then 1 else 0 end )  as "31-60 days"   ,sum(case when (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 60) and                  (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 90) then 1 else 0 end)  as "61-90 days"   ,sum(case when (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 90) and                  (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 120) then 1 else 0 end)  as "91-120 days"   ,sum(case when (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk  > 120) then 1 else 0 end)  as ">120 days" from    store_sales   ,store_returns   ,store   ,date_dim d1   ,date_dim d2 where     d2.d_year = 1999 and d2.d_moy  = 5 and ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number and ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk and ss_sold_date_sk   = d1.d_date_sk and sr_returned_date_sk   = d2.d_date_sk and ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk and ss_store_sk = s_store_sk and d1.d_date between (d2.d_date - interval '120' day)                and d2.d_date group by    s_store_name   ,s_company_id   ,s_street_number   ,s_street_name   ,s_street_type   ,s_suite_number   ,s_city   ,s_county   ,s_state   ,s_zip order by s_store_name         ,s_company_id         ,s_street_number         ,s_street_name         ,s_street_type         ,s_suite_number         ,s_city         ,s_county         ,s_state         ,s_zip limit 100;
rewritten_query:
with store_agg as (
    select ss.ss_store_sk,
           sum(case when sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk <= 30 then 1 else 0 end) as "30 days",
           sum(case when sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk between 31 and 60 then 1 else 0 end) as "31-60 days",
           sum(case when sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk between 61 and 90 then 1 else 0 end) as "61-90 days",
           sum(case when sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk between 91 and 120 then 1 else 0 end) as "91-120 days",
           0 as ">120 days"
    from store_sales ss
    join store_returns sr
      on ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
     and ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
     and ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
     and ss.ss_sold_date_sk between sr.sr_returned_date_sk - 120 and sr.sr_returned_date_sk
    join date_dim d2 on sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    where d2.d_year = 1999 and d2.d_moy = 5
    group by ss.ss_store_sk
)
select s.s_store_name, s.s_company_id, s.s_street_number, s.s_street_name, s.s_street_type,
       s.s_suite_number, s.s_city, s.s_county, s.s_state, s.s_zip,
       sa."30 days", sa."31-60 days", sa."61-90 days", sa."91-120 days", sa.">120 days"
from store_agg sa
join store s on sa.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
order by s.s_store_name, s.s_company_id, s.s_street_number, s.s_street_name, s.s_street_type,
         s.s_suite_number, s.s_city, s.s_county, s.s_state, s.s_zip
limit 100;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Eliminate the redundant join to date_dim d1. The filter d1.d_date between d2.d_date - interval '120' day and d2.d_date is equivalent to ss_sold_date_sk between sr_returned_date_sk - 120 and sr_returned_date_sk, since TPC-DS d_date_sk is a sequential (Julian) key and the query itself already treats date_sk differences as day differences. This removes one index lookup per joined row.
The ">120 days" bucket is provably always 0 because the 120-day range condition guarantees sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 120. Replace the CASE expression with the constant 0.
Rewrite bucket conditions using BETWEEN (31-60, 61-90, 91-120) for readability; integer diff guarantees equivalence to the >x AND <=y pairs.
Convert implicit comma joins into explicit ANSI JOIN syntax for clarity and better join-condition visibility to the optimizer.
